note: DRAFT 2 for approval: Lake Hylia's sub-biomes. Shapes mark places for authoring only: in the game, props thin out at the edges and zones overlap, and the shore-to-deep banding (reeds, lily pads, submerged weed, bare bottom) follows every shore from the depth map. Circles (x, z, r) or capsules (x1, z1, x2, z2, r) in world units; 'auto' zones come from the depth map.

zones.name: Gerudo river inflow
zones.props: smooth river stones, foam at the mouth, ribbon weed bent downstream

zones.name: Lab shore and dock
zones.props: dock pilings with cross-bracing, a sunken crib, shade
zones.fish: bass in the shade, catfish under the dock by day

zones.name: North beach shallows
zones.props: sedge tussocks at the edge, a few reeds, open sand lanes
zones.fish: minnow schools by day, carp, bass at dawn and dusk

zones.name: Pond-house cove
zones.props: lily field with a few flowers, reed walls, a stump under the pads

zones.name: West bridge and grave islet point
zones.props: bridge pilings, iwagumi-style boulders running out from the islet
zones.fish: bass at the point, pike in ambush, catfish in the rocks by day

zones.name: West weed flat
zones.props: eelgrass meadows with sand lanes, a laydown log

zones.name: Drop-off (weed edge)
zones.shape: auto: where the depth falls fast around the basin
zones.props: tall ribbon weed at the lip, scattered boulders down the slope
zones.fish: big bass and pike holding at the edge

zones.name: Deep basin
zones.fish: pike and big bass cruising, carp by day; big fish rising at dusk (catfish stay on the banks)

zones.name: South bridge pilings
zones.fish: bass, catfish under the pilings by day, roaming at night

zones.name: Island shallows
zones.props: weed flat, pebbles near the island
zones.fish: loach at night, carp, catfish cruising the shallows at night

zones.name: East weed flats
zones.props: pondweed and eelgrass clumps, sand lanes

zones.name: South reed bank and lily cove
zones.props: reed walls, lily pads, duckweed caught in the reeds
zones.fish: bass at dawn and dusk, catfish along the reeds at night

zones.name: Pillar ruins (by the Zora's Domain way)
zones.props: weed and fallen stone beside the ruins, never on the walkway, the plaza or the pillars
zones.fish: catfish and big bass holding in the shade of the blocks by day; loach at night
zones._exclude_doc: No props on the entrance or in front of it: the stone walkway from the shore, the sunken plaza, the way out of the Zora's Domain tunnel (it opens at the bottom of the plaza, x -916 z 3600 y -1553, under the walkway's end) and right round the pillars. Plants and stones beside all that are fine.

zones.name: Dry dock (north beach)
zones.props: a short dock on pilings, a boat's mooring later, sedge along the beach
zones.fish: minnows and greengill around the pilings, bass at dawn

zones.name: Under the island's dead tree
zones.props: branches and a log fallen from the island's dead tree (the lake's only tree): the only wood in the lake
